en.headline: HKEX posts first quarterly profit decline in over two years
en.dek: Net profit for the third quarter fell 1 per cent year on year to HK$4.86 billion as cash market turnover moderated, though nine-month results remained at record levels.
body: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing reported its first year-on-year decline in quarterly profit in more than two years on Friday, as trading activity in the cash market cooled.

Net profit attributable to shareholders for the three months ended 30 September slipped about 1 per cent to HK$4.86 billion, according to the exchange operator’s filing. Revenue and other income edged up 1 per cent to HK$7.87 billion.

Average daily turnover on the stock exchange fell 11 per cent to HK$254.2 billion during the quarter. Gains from commodities trading, Northbound Stock Connect volumes and higher listing fees partially offset lower cash-market and Southbound fees.

For the first nine months of 2026, revenue and other income rose 12 per cent to a record HK$24.57 billion, while profit climbed 15 per cent to HK$15.43 billion. Chief executive Bonnie Chan said the results came amid rising macroeconomic uncertainty.

zh.headline: 港交所第三季盈利按年下跌 為逾兩年來首次
zh.dek: 第三季股東應佔淨利潤按年跌約1%至48.6億元，現金市場成交量回落，惟首九個月業績仍創新高。
body: 香港交易及結算所周五公布，第三季盈利按年下跌，為逾兩年來首次，主因現金市場交投活動放緩。
截至9月30日止三個月，股東應佔淨利潤約按年下降1%至48.6億元。收入及其他收益微升1%至78.7億元。
期內股票市場平均每日成交額下跌11%至2542億元。商品交易、北向股票互聯互通成交及上市費收入增加，部分抵銷現金市場及南向費用下降的影響。
2026年首九個月，收入及其他收益按年升12%至245.7億元的紀錄水平，盈利則升15%至154.3億元。行政總裁陳翊庭表示，業績公布之際宏觀經濟不確定性上升。
